$comment: DRAFT for developer review. Name: VeloPair (gate #1 closed 2026-08-17); attorney trademark clearance still pending. This object records the OUTPUT of a scoring engine. The standard deliberately defines no scoring mathematics: engines compete on the same data (design principle 1), and scoring mechanisms are patent-encumbered territory (see docs/RESEARCH.md section 4, Giant US 11878214).
title: Compatibility
description: A match result: which engine looked at which rider, ride profile and bike, and what it concluded. Scores are engine-specific and comparable only within one engine and version.

spec_version.description: Version of this specification the document conforms to.

engine.description: Who computed this. Mandatory: a score without an engine is meaningless under the data-not-score architecture.

rider_ref.description: profile_id of the Rider document used as input.

ride_profile_ref.description: profile_id of the Ride Profile document used as input.

bike_ref.description: profile_id of the Bike document used as input.

confidence.description: The engine's own confidence in the score, typically driven by input completeness.

breakdown.description: Optional per-dimension scores. Dimension names are engine-defined, not standardized.

extensions.description: Engine-specific data under reverse-domain keys. Consumers must ignore unknown extensions.
